title: Lower weight decay (WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 -> 0.1)
description: Halved cautious Muon weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1, everything else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003675, worse than baseline 1.002279 (about +0.14%). This is the fifth consecutive round where a single isolated hyperparameter perturbation near the current baseline has failed to improve on it -- depth up, matrix_lr up, matrix_lr down, warmdown ratio up, and now weight_decay down have all regressed by similar small margins (~0.3-0.4%). The baseline set at DEPTH=10 appears to be at or very near a fairly sharp local optimum across multiple independent axes (architecture, Muon LR magnitude in both directions, LR schedule shape, and now regularization strength). Future rounds should stop doing single-axis +/-25% perturbations around this point and instead try either (a) a qualitatively different mechanism (e.g. architecture: window pattern, MLP width ratio, value-embedding gating) or (b) a joint/correlated change, since independent axes have each been probed and each one taken alone loses.
